Game Overview

Underground Scout is a adventure title where navigate a perilous labyrinth in your advanced scout ship, collecting precious oxygone ore to avert an oxygen crisis. Master intuitive controls, avoid collisions, and strategically dismantle weightless boulders while immersing yourself in a captivating underground adventure laden with both challenges and rewards.
